# Christ Consciousness – The Goal for Each One of Us

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Loving blessings. Brother Chidananda reflects on the profound meaning of Christ Consciousness (*Kutastha Chaitanya*), which is the cosmic intelligence of God present in every atom of creation. This state of universal love and infinite joy is the ultimate goal of every searching soul.

### The Divine Awakening Within

Our Guru, Paramahansa Yogananda, taught that Jesus did not want us to merely worship him; he wanted us to experience the same Christ Consciousness that he attained. In the stillness of meditation, when our restless thoughts are perfectly quiet, the vast, cosmic light of Christ-love naturally enters our minds.

### Establishing Universal Goodwill

When we live in Christ Consciousness, we expand our heart's love past the boundaries of our family and nation. We see every human being as our brother or sister, and the earth as our cosmic home.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Meditation Target:** Focus your gaze at the Christ center between the eyebrows (spiritual eye) to tune in to Christ-love.
* **Universal Love:** Express absolute compassion and kindness to everyone you encounter, releasing all judgment.
* **Aum Vibrations:** Tune into the cosmic sound of Aum during your silent sadhana to expand your awareness.
* **Daily Study:** Read a portion of Yogananda's commentaries on the Gospels (*The Second Coming of Christ*) to guide your intellect.

May Christ Consciousness shine in your heart. Jai Guru!
